composition: West front and the pair of slender spires · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the cathedral close, the west front of Roskilde Cathedral shows its pair of tall pointed spires above the brick Gothic body. The night is partly cloudy with cloud cover about 76%, about 12.0°C, so the moon is mostly hidden and the brick reads by street lamps. The square is empty. Later royal burial chapels are not claimed as part of this west-front frame.
